editorial:
Ever wondered what actually happens when the cameras stop rolling on one of the most intense prison shows ever? You get a front-row seat to all the drama with this documentary. It brings together the cast and crew to talk about the final season of Wentworth, giving you a look at the secrets and stories that never made it into the actual episodes. You will see the actors stepping out of their tough prisoner personas to share how they felt about their characters' journeys and the friendships they built on set over the years.

What really makes this special is how honest the cast is about the pressure of filming such a heavy show. The pacing is quick, and the behind-the-scenes clips make it feel like you are hanging out with the stars. While it is mostly a talking-head style film, the passion is real. It is a great way to say goodbye to the series.
endingExplained: The documentary wraps up by showing the emotional goodbye between the actors and the crew. They reflect on the final episodes of the series and explain how the main character's story finally comes to a close. You see the cast discuss the legacy of the show and how it changed their lives. It ends on a hopeful note, focusing on the bond they shared while playing such gritty roles in a fake prison.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Wentworth and wants to see the actors in real life.
